name: Heartbreak
overview: Scripture reveals that God is intimately close to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering comfort and salvation in their distress. The psalmist's prayers express deep sorrow and reliance on the Lord, who hears the cries of the needy and sustains the righteous by bearing their burdens. God not only draws near to heal broken hearts but also binds up their wounds, encouraging believers to trust wholly in Him rather than their own understanding.
